entries.title: Psalms 57:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Michtam of David when he fled from Saul into the cave.>> Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me! For my soul trusts in You; And in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge, Until [these] calamities have passed by.

entries.title: Psalms 57:2
segments: I will cry out to God Most High, To God who performs [all things] for me.

entries.title: Psalms 57:3
segments: He shall send from heaven and save me; He reproaches the one who would swallow me up. Selah God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

entries.title: Psalms 57:4
segments: My soul [is] among lions; I lie [among] the sons of men Who are set on fire, Whose teeth [are] spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.

entries.title: Psalms 57:5
segments: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] Your glory [be] above all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 57:6
segments: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down; They have dug a pit before me; Into the midst of it they [themselves] have fallen. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 57:7
segments: ¶My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise.

entries.title: Psalms 57:8
segments: Awake, my glory! Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.

entries.title: Psalms 57:9
segments: I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing to You among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 57:10
segments: For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens, And Your truth unto the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 57:11
segments: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; [Let] Your glory [be] above all the earth.
